title: Guth's 1981 inflation proposal
summary: Inflation was proposed as a possible solution to the horizon and flatness problems. It is a model, not a direct observation.
body: Alan H. Guth, "Inflationary universe: A possible solution to the horizon and flatness problems" (Physical Review D, 1981), proposed a brief early phase of accelerated expansion. The title says "a possible solution." The v1 timeline's factor of 10^26 and the exact second-fractions were not copied from this paper in this pass. Treat inflation as a widely used model whose direct observational status is weaker than the existence of the cosmic microwave background.
